data.title: Pier Point
data.about:
Pier Point at Rashid Yachts & Marina by Emaar offers stunning waterfront living in Dubai. This luxurious development features 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments and townhouses. Pier Point 1's location provides breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and easy access to world-class marina facilities. The Emaar Pier Point project combines luxury and convenience, perfect for those seeking a sophisticated coastal lifestyle.

Residents can enjoy beautifully designed Pier Point luxury apartments with high ceilings, open layouts, and floor-to-ceiling windows. Pier Point apartments in Dubai also offer flexible payment plans, making it an ideal investment in Pier Point Emaar. Enjoy waterfront living at Pier Point, with easy access to Rashid Yachts & Marina's lively promenade, restaurants, and boutiques.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy World-Class Amenities at a Prime Location
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Pier Point at Rashid Yachts & Marina offers stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, providing a serene coastal lifestyle.
  • The Pier Point luxury apartments and townhouses feature modern designs, spacious layouts, and high-end finishes, catering to a sophisticated living experience.
  • Pier Point by Emaar offers flexible payment options, making it an attractive investment for both end-users and investors.
  • Residents enjoy easy access to Rashid Yachts & Marina Pier Point's state-of-the-art facilities, ideal for yacht owners and enthusiasts.
  • Pier Point offers flexible living solutions by offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and 3-bedroom townhouses.
  • The vibrant waterfront promenade is lined with trendy cafes, high-end restaurants, and boutique shops for a dynamic lifestyle.
  • Pier Point 1 location provides convenient access to both historic Dubai and the modern, bustling Downtown Dubai.

location_tile.title: Enjoy Stunning Views of the Water and Dubai Skyline
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Pier Point at Rashid Yachts & Marina is ideally located in Dubai’s new yachting hub, offering luxurious waterfront living. Residents enjoy easy access to the vibrant marina and nearby attractions, blending coastal relaxation with city convenience. The Pier Point by Emaar development provides stunning views and a peaceful atmosphere just minutes from Dubai’s lively city center. This prime location ensures the perfect balance of serenity and urban life, making it a standout in Dubai real estate.

10 Minutes to Sheikh Zayed Road
15 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
20 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
20 Minutes to the Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa 
20 Minutes to Dubai Creek Harbour
